title: How To Edit The SEO Elements Of An Individual Member Profile Page
text:
## How To Edit The SEO Elements Of An Individual Member Profile Page
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682652

## Steps
Log in to the Admin Area .
Navigate to My Members > Search Members .
Locate the member profile to update.
Hover over the Actions menu for that member, then click Quick Edit .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184628044/original/G0CMFRMvl4LKLN84ZAWQdT7LqqYCb7WFwA.png?1788421581 | alt: ]
Click the Advanced Options tab.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184628088/original/Rc3bIeypqF-ievkRb0X00ZEyRg1pCKbRiA.png?1788421624 | alt: ]
Scroll down until the SEO options become visible.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12184627877/original/sJ7L6NC6fzeu1GorNfEqVYajfNEeYRIGJw.png?1788421455 | alt: ]
